Money · in French

Health reimbursements

For households in France who pay medical costs up front: each visit or purchase, what the national health insurance (Sécurité sociale) and the top-up insurer (mutuelle) paid back, what is still owed, and a ready-to-copy reminder when a reimbursement is late. Yearly totals per person and per type of care. No diagnosis recorded, no reimbursement rates built in. A tracking aid, not professional advice.
